notes: On Site And On My Way Stops Show First: the stop you are at or heading to is pinned to the top of Route, Home, Winterization and Testing.
Winterization Complete Clears The Set Date Chip: a finished Winterization no longer shows an old Set Date chip.
Cleaner Invoices: the invoice header is tidier, the status reads Paid in Title Case, and an invoice opens at the top.

Invoice Amount Is Always Editable: you can change the Amount even on a paid QuickBooks invoice, with a short note on what the next QuickBooks sync will do. On iPhone, tapping the Amount selects the whole total.
